7.80.d: एषा सया नव्यमायुर्दधाना गूढ्वी तमो जयोतिषोषाबोधि | अग्र एति युवतिरह्रयाणा पराचिकितत सूर्यं यज्ञमग्निम ||
7.80.e: Giving fresh life when she hath hid the darkness, this Dawn hath wakened there with new-born lustre.  Youthful and unrestrained she cometh forward: she hath turned thoughts to Sun and fire and worship.
May blessed Mornings shine on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes,  Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.81.d: परत्यु अदर्श्यायत्युछन्ती दुहिता दिवः | अपो महि वययति चक्षसे तमो जयोतिष कर्णोति सूनरी ||
7.81.e: ADVANCING, sending forth her rays, the Daughter of the Sky is seen.  Uncovering, that we may see, the mighty gloom, the friendly Lady makes the light.

7.81.d: उदुस्रियाः सर्जते सूर्यः सचानुद्यन नक्षत्रमर्चिवत | तवेदुषो वयुषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि ||
7.81.e: The Sun ascending, the refulgent Star, pours down his beams together with the Dawn.  O Dawn, at thine arising, and the Sun's, may we attain the share allotted us.

7.81.d: परति तवा दुहितर्दिव उषो जीरा अभुत्स्महि | या वहसि पुरुस्पार्हं वनन्वति रत्नं न दाशुषे मयः ||
7.81.e: Promptly we woke to welcome thee, O Uṣas, Daughter of the Sky,  Thee, Bounteous One, who bringest all we long to have, and to the offerer health and wealth.

7.81.d: उछन्ती या कर्णोषि मंहना महि परख्यै देवि सवर्द्र्शे | तस्यास्ते रत्नभाज ईमहे वयं सयाम मातुर्न सूनवः ||
7.81.e: Thou, dawning, workest fain to light the great world, yea, heaven, Goddess! that it may be seen.  We yearn to be thine own, Dealer of Wealth: may we be to this Mother like her sons.

7.81.d: तच्चित्रं राध आ भरोषो यद दीर्घश्रुत्तमम | यत तेदिवो दुहितर्मर्तभोजनं तद रास्व भुनजामहै ||
7.81.e: Bring us that wondrous bounty, Dawn, that shall be famed most far away.  What, Child of Heaven, thou hast of nourishment for man, bestow thou on us to enjoy.

7.81.d: शरवः सूरिभ्यो अम्र्तं वसुत्वनं वाजानस्मभ्यं गोमतः | चोदयित्री मघोनः सून्र्तावत्युषा उछदप सरिधः ||
7.81.e: Give to our princes opulence and immortal fame, and strength in herds of kine to us.  May she who prompts the wealthy, Lady of sweet strains, may Uṣas dawn our foes away.

7.82.d: इन्द्रावरुणा युवमध्वराय नो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यछतम | दीर्घप्रयज्युमति यो वनुष्यति वयं जयेम पर्तनासु दूढ्यः ||
7.82.e: GRANT us your strong protection, IndraVaruṇa, our people, and our family, for sacrifice.  May we subdue in fight our evil-hearted foes, him who attacks the man steadfast in lengthened rites.

7.82.d: सम्राळ अन्यः सवराळ अन्य उच्यते वां महान्ताविन्द्रावरुणा महावसू | विश्वे देवासः परमे वयोमनि सं वामोजोव्र्षणा सं बलं दधुः ||
7.82.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, mighty and very rich One of you is called Monarch and One Autocrat.  All Gods in the most lofty region of the air have, O ye Steers, combined all power and might in you.

Ye with your strength have pierced the fountains of the floods: the Sun have ye brought forward as the Lord in heaven.  Cheered by this magic draught ye, Indra-Varuṇa, made the dry places stream, made songs of praise flow forth.

7.82.d: म | इन्द्रावरुणा मदे अस्य मायिनो.अपिन्वतमपितः पिन्वतं धियः ||
7.82.e: In battels and in frays we ministering priests, kneeling upon our knees for furtherance of our weal,  Invoke you, only you, the Lords of twofold wealth, you prompt to hear, we bards, O Indra-Varuṇa.

7.82.d: युवामिद युत्सु पर्तनासु वह्नयो युवां कषेमस्य परसवे मितज्ञवः | ईशाना वस्व उभयस्य कारव इन्द्रावरुणा सुहवा हवामहे ||
7.82.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, as ye created all these creatures of the world by your surpassing might,  In peace and quiet Mitra waits on Varuṇa, the Other, awful, with the Maruis seeks renown.

7.82.d: इन्द्रावरुणा यदिमानि चक्रथुर्विश्वा जातानि भुवनस्यमज्मना | कषेमेण मित्रो वरुणं दुवस्यति मरुद्भिरुग्रः शुभमन्य ईयते ||
7.82.e: That Varuṇa's high worth may shine preeminent, these Twain have measured each his proper power and might.  The One subdueth the destructive enemy; the Other with a few furthereth many a man.

7.82.d: महे शुल्काय वरुणस्य नु तविष ओजो मिमाते धरुवमस्य यत सवम | अजामिमन्यः शनथयन्तमातिरद दभ्रेभिरन्यः पर वर्णोति भूयसः ||
7.82.e: No trouble, no misfortune, Indra-Varuṇa, no woe from any side assails the mortal man  Whose sacrifice, O Gods, ye visit and enjoy: ne’er doth the crafty guile of mortal injure him.

7.82.d: न तमंहो न दुरितानि मर्त्यमिन्द्रावरुणा न तपः कुतश्चन | यस्य देवा गछथो वीथो अध्वरं न तं मर्तस्य नशते परिह्व्र्तिः ||
7.82.e: With your divine protection, Heroes, come to us: mine invncation hear, if ye be pleased therewith.  Bestow ye upon us, O Indra-Varuṇa, your friendship and your kinship and your favouring grace.

7.82.d: अर्वां नरा दैव्येनावसा गतं शर्णुतं हवं यदि मे जुजोषथः | युवोर्हि सख्यमुत वा यदाप्यं मार्डीकमिन्द्रावरुणा नि यछतम ||
7.82.e: In battle after battle, Indra-Varuṇa, be ye our Champions, ye who are the peoples' strength,  When both opposing bands invoke you for the fight, and men that they may gain offspring and progeny.

7.82.d: अस्माकमिन्द्रावरुणा भरे-भरे पुरोयोधा भवतं कर्ष्ट्योजसा | यद वां हवन्त उभये अध सप्र्धि नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातिषु ||
7.82.e: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman vouchsafe us glory and great shelter spreading far.  We think of the beneficent light of Aditi, and Savitar's song of praise, the God who strengthens Law.

7.82.d: अस्मे इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा दयुम्नं यछन्तु महि शर्मसप्रथः | अवध्रं जयोतिरदितेरताव्र्धो देवस्य शलोकं सवितुर्मनामहे ||

7.83.d: युवां नरा पश्यमानास आप्यं पराचा गव्यन्तः पर्थुपर्शवो ययुः | दासा च वर्त्रा हतमार्याणि च सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणावसावतम ||
7.83.e: LOOKING to you and your alliance, O ye Men, armed with broad axes they went forward, fain for spoil.  Ye smote and slew his Dāsa and his Āryan enemies, and helped Sudās with favour, Indra-Varuṇa.

7.83.d: यत्रा नरः समयन्ते कर्तध्वजो यस्मिन्नाजा भवति किंचन परियम | यत्रा भयन्ते भुवना सवर्द्र्शस्तत्रा न इन्द्रावरुणाधि वोचतम ||
7.83.e: Where heroes come together with their banners raised, in the encounter where is naught for us to love,  Where all things that behold the light are terrified, there did ye comfort us, O Indra-Varuṇa.

7.83.d: सं भूम्या अन्ता धवसिरा अद्र्क्षतेन्द्रावरुणा दिवि घोषारुहत | अस्थुर्जनानामुप मामरातयो.अर्वागवसा हवनश्रुता गतम ||
7.83.e: The boundaries of earth were seen all dark with dust: O Indra-Varuṇa, the shout went up to heaven.  The enmities of the people compassed me about. Ye heard my calling and ye came to me with help.

7.83.d: इन्द्रावरुणा वधनाभिरप्रति भेदं वन्वन्ता पर सुदासमावतम | बरह्माण्येषां शर्णुतं हवीमनि सत्या तर्त्सूनामभवत पुरोहितिः ||
7.83.e: With your resistless weapons, Indra-Varuṇa, ye conquered Bheda and ye gave Sudās your aid.  Ye heard the prayers of these amid the cries of war: effectual was the service of the Trtsus' priest.

7.83.d: इन्द्रावरुणावभ्या तपन्ति माघान्यर्यो वनुषामरातयः | युवं हि वस्व उभयस्य राजथो.अध समा नो.अवतं पार्ये दिवि ||
7.83.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, the wickedness of foes and mine assailants' hatred sorely trouble me.  Ye Twain are Lords of riches both of earth and heaven: so grant to us your aid on the decisive day.

7.83.d: युवां हवन्त उभयास आजिष्विन्द्रं च वस्वो वरुणं चसातये | यत्र राजभिर्दशभिर्निबाधितं पर सुदासमावतं तर्त्सुभिः सह ||
7.83.e: The men of both the hosts invoked you in the fight, Indra and Varuṇa, that they might win the wealth,  What time ye helped Sudās, with all the Trtsu folk, when the Ten Kings had pressed him down in their attack.

7.83.d: दश राजानः समिता अयज्यवः सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणा न युयुधुः | सत्या नर्णामद्मसदामुपस्तुतिर्देवा एषामभवन देवहूतिषु ||
7.83.e: Ten Kings who worshipped not, O Indra-Varuṇa, confederate, in war prevailed not o’er Sudās.  True was the boast of heroes sitting at the feast: so at their invocations Gods were on their side.

7.83.d: दाशराज्ञे परियत्ताय विश्वतः सुदास इन्द्रावरुणावशिक्षतम | शवित्यञ्चो यत्र नमसा कपर्दिनो धिया धीवन्तो असपन्त तर्त्सवः ||
7.83.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, ye gave Sudās your aid when the Ten Kings in battle compassed him about,  There where the white-robed Trtsus with their braided hair, skilled in song worshipped you with homage and with hymn.

7.83.d: वर्त्राण्यन्यः समिथेषु जिघ्नते वरतान्यन्यो अभि रक्षते सदा | हवामहे वां वर्षणा सुव्र्क्तिभिरस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा शर्म यछतम ||
7.83.e: One of you Twain destroys the Vṛtras in the fight, the Other evermore maintains his holy Laws.  We call on you, ye Mighty, with our hymns of praise. Vouchsafe us your protection, Indra-Varuṇa.
May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman vouchsafe us glory and great shelter spreading far.  We think of the beneficent light of Aditi, and Savitar's song of praise, the God who strengthens Law.

7.84.d: आ वां राजानावध्वरे वव्र्त्यां हव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः | पर वां घर्ताची बाह्वोर्दधाना परि तमना विषुरूपा जिगाति ||
7.84.e: KINGS, Indra-Varuṇa, I would turn you hither to this our sacrifice with gifts and homage.  Held in both arms the ladle, dropping fatness, goes of itself to you whose forms are varied.

7.84.d: युवो राष्ट्रं बर्हदिन्वति दयौर्यौ सेत्र्भिररज्जुभिः सिनीथः | परि नो हेळो वरुणस्य वर्ज्या उरुं न इन्द्रः कर्णवदु लोकम ||
7.84.e: Dyaus quickens and promotes your high dominion who bind with bonds not wrought of rope or cordage.  Far from us still be Varuṇa's displeasure may Indra give us spacious room to dwell in.

7.84.d: कर्तं नो यज्ञं विदथेषु चारुं कर्तं बरह्माणि सूरिषुप्रशस्ता | उपो रयिर्देवजूतो न एतु पर णः सपार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेतम ||
7.84.e: Make ye our sacrifice fair amid the assemblies: make ye our prayers approved among our princes.  May God-sent riches come for our possession: further ye us with your delightful succours.

7.84.d: अस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा विश्ववारं रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम | पर य आदित्यो अन्र्ता मिनात्यमिता शूरो दयते वसूनि ||
7.84.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, vouchsafe us riches with store of treasure, food, and every blessing;  For the Āditya, banisher of falsehood, the Hero, dealeth wealth in boundless plenty.

7.84.d: इयमिन्द्रं वरुणमष्ट मे गीः परावत तोके तनये तूतुजाना | सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम यूयं पात ... ||
7.84.e: May this my song reach Varuṇa and Indra, and, strongly urging, win me sons and offspring.  To the Gods’ banquet may we go with riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.85.d: पुनीषे वामरक्षसं मनीषां सोममिन्द्राय वरुणाय जुह्वत | घर्तप्रतीकामुषसं न देवीं ता नो यामन्नुरुष्यतामभीके ||
7.85.e: FOR you I deck a harmless hymn, presenting the Soma juice to Varuṇa and Indra-  A hymn that shines like heavenly Dawn with fatness. May they be near us on the march and guard us.

7.85.d: सपर्धन्ते वा उ देवहूये अत्र येषु धवजेषु दिद्यवः पतन्ति | युवं तानिन्द्रावरुणावमित्रान हतं पराचः शर्वा विषूचः ||
7.85.e: Here where the arrows fall amid the banners both hosts invoke the Gods in emulation.  O Indra-Varuṇa, smite back those-our foemen,yea, smite them withyour shaft to every quarter.

7.85.d: आपश्चिद धि सवयशसः सदस्सु देवीरिन्द्रं वरुणं देवता धुः | कर्ष्टीरन्यो धारयति परविक्ता वर्त्राण्यन्यो अप्रतीनि हन्ति ||
7.85.e: Self-lucid in their seats, e’en heavenly Waters endowed with Godhead Varuṇa and Indra.  One of these holds the folk distinct and sundered, the Other smites and slays resistless foemen.

7.85.d: स सुक्रतुरतचिदस्तु होता य आदित्य शवसा वां नमस्वान | आववर्तदवसे वां हविष्मानसदित स सुविताय परयस्वान ||
7.85.e: Wise be the priest and skilled in Law Eternal, who with his sacred gifts and oration.  Brings you to aid us with your might, Ādityas: let him have viands to promote his welfare.
May this my song reach Varuṇa and Indra, and, strongly urging, win me sons and offspring.  To the Gods’ banquet may we go with riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods with blessings.

7.86.d: धीरा तवस्य महिना जनूंषि वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी चिदुर्वी | पर नाकं रष्वं नुनुदे बर्हन्तं दविता नक्षत्रम्पप्रथच्च भूम ||
7.86.e: WISE, verily, are creatures through his greatness who stayed ever, spacious heaven and earth asunder;  Who urged the high and mighty sky to motion, the Star of old, and spread the earth before him.

7.86.d: उत सवया तन्वा सं वदे तत कदा नवन्तर्वरुणे भुवानि | किं मे हव्यमह्र्णानो जुषेत कदा मर्ळीकं सुमना अभि खयम ||
7.86.e: With mine own heart I commune on the question how Varuṇa and I may be united.  What gift of mine will he accept unangered? When may I calmly look and find him gracious?

7.86.d: पर्छे तदेनो वरुण दिद्र्क्षूपो एमि चिकितुषो विप्र्छम | समानमिन मे कवयश्चिदाहुरयं ह तुभ्यं वरुणो हर्णीते ||
7.86.e: Fain to know this is my sin I question others: I seek the wise, O Varuṇa, and ask them.  This one same answer even the sages gave me, "Surely this Varuṇa is angry with thee."

7.86.d: किमाग आस वरुण जयेष्ठं यत सतोतारं जिघांससि सखायम | पर तन मे वोचो दूळभ सवधावो.अव तवानेना नमसा तुर इयाम ||
7.86.e: What, Varuṇa, hath been my chief transgression, that thou wouldst slay the friend who sings thy praises?  Tell me, Unconquerable Lord, and quickly sinless will I approach thee with mine homage.

7.86.d: अव दरुग्धानि पित्र्या सर्जा नो.अव या वयं चक्र्मा तनूभिः | अव राजन पशुत्र्पं न तायुं सर्जा वत्सं न दाम्नो वसिष्ठम ||
7.86.e: Free us from sins committed by our fathers, from those wherein we have ourselves offended.  O King, loose, like a thief who feeds the cattle, as from the cord a calf, set free Vasiṣṭha.

7.86.d: न स सवो दक्षो वरुण धरुतिः सा सुरा मन्युर्विभीदकोचित्तिः | अस्ति जयायान कनीयस उपारे सवप्नश्चनेदन्र्तस्य परयोता ||
7.86.e: Not our own will betrayed us, but seduction, thoughtlessness, Varuṇa wine, dice, or anger.  The old is near to lead astray the younger: even sleep removeth not all evil-doing.

7.86.d: अरं दासो न मीळ्हुषे कराण्यहं देवाय भूर्णये.अनागाः | अचेतयदचितो देवो अर्यो गर्त्सं राये कवितरो जुनाति ||
7.86.e: Slavelike may I do service to the Bounteous, serve, free from sin, the God inclined to anger.  This gentle Lord gives wisdom to the simple: the wiser God leads on the wise to riches.

7.86.d: अयं सु तुभ्यं वरुण सवधावो हर्दि सतोम उपश्रितश्चिदस्तु | शं नः कषेमे शमु योगे नो अस्तु यूयं पात ... ||
7.86.e: O Lord, O Varuṇa, may this laudation come close to thee and lie within thy spirit.  May it be well with us in rest and labour. Preserve us ever-more, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.87.d: रदत पथो वरुणः सूर्याय परार्णांसि समुद्रिया नदीनाम | सर्गो न सर्ष्टो अर्वतीरतायञ्चकार महीरवनीरहभ्यः ||
7.87.e: VARUNA cut a pathway out for Sūrya, and led the watery floods of rivers onward.  The Mares, as in a race, speed on in order. He made great channels for the days to follow.

7.87.d: आत्मा ते वातो रज आ नवीनोत पशुर्न भूर्णिर्यवसे ससवान | अन्तर्मही बर्हती रोदसीमे विश्वा ते धाम वरुण परियाणि ||
7.87.e: The wind, thy breath, hath sounded through the region like a wild beast that seeks his food in pastures.  Within these two, exalted Earth and Heaven, O Varuṇa, are all the forms thou lovest.

7.87.d: परि सपशो वरुणस्य समदिष्टा उभे पश्यन्ति रोदसी सुमेके | रतावानः कवयो यज्ञधीराः परचेतसो य इषयन्त मन्म ||
7.87.e: Varuṇa's spies, sent forth upon their errand, survey the two world-halves well formed and fashioned.  Wise are they, holy, skilled in sacrifices, the furtherers of the praise-songs of the prudent.

7.87.d: उवाच मे वरुणो मेधिराय तरिः सप्त नामाघ्न्या बिभर्ति | विद्वान पदस्य गुह्या न वोचद युगाय विप्र उपराय शिक्षन ||
7.87.e: To me who understand hath Varuṇa spoken, the names borne by the Cow are three times seven.  The sapient God, knowing the place's secret, shall speak as ’twere to teach the race that cometh.

7.87.d: तिस्रो दयावो निहिता अन्तरस्मिन तिस्रो भूमीरुपराः षड्विधानाः | गर्त्सो राजा वरुणश्चक्र एतं दिवि परेङखंहिरण्ययं शुभे कम ||
7.87.e: On him three heavens rest and are supported, and the three earths are there in sixfold order.  The wise King Varuṇa hath made in heaven that Golden Swing to cover it with glory.

7.87.d: अव सिन्धुं वरुणो दयौरिव सथाद दरप्सो न शवेतो मर्गस्तुविष्मान | गम्भीरशंसो रजसो विमानः सुपारक्षत्रः सतो अस्य राजा ||
7.87.e: Like Varuṇa from heaven he sinks in Sindhu, like a white-shining spark, a strong wild creature.  Ruling in depths and meting out the region, great saving power hath he, this world's Controller.

7.87.d: यो मर्ळयाति चक्रुषे चिदागो वयं सयाम वरुणे अनागाः | अनु वरतान्यदितेरधन्तो यूयं पात ... ||
7.87.e: Before this Varuṇa may we be sinless him who shows mercy even to the sinner-  While we are keeping Aditi's ordinances. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.88.d: पर शुन्ध्युवं वरुणाय परेष्ठां मतिं वसिष्ठ मीळ्हुषे भरस्व | य ईमर्वाञ्चं करते यजत्रं सहस्रामघं वर्षणं बर्हन्तम ||
7.88.e: PRESENT to Varuṇa thine hymn, Vasiṣṭha, bright, most delightful to the Bounteous Giver,  Who bringeth on to us the Bull, the lofty, the Holy, laden with a thousand treasures.

7.88.d: अधा नवस्य सन्द्र्शं जगन्वानग्नेरनीकं वरुणस्य मंसि | सवर्यदश्मन्नधिपा उ अन्धो.अभि मा वपुर्द्र्शये निनीयात ||
7.88.e: And now, as I am come before his presence, I take the face of Varuṇa for Agni's.  So might he bring-Lord also of the darkness-the light in heaven that I may see its beauty!

7.88.d: आ यद रुहाव वरुणश्च नावं पर यत समुद्रमीरयावमध्यम | अधि यदपां सनुभिश्चराव पर परेङख ईङखयावहै शुभे कम ||
7.88.e: When Varuṇa and I embark together and urge our boat into the midst of ocean,  We, when we ride o’er ridges of the waters, will swing within that swing and there be happy.

7.88.d: वसिष्ठं ह वरुणो नाव्याधाद रषिं चकार सवपा महोभिः | सतोतारं विप्रः सुदिनत्वे अह्नां यान नु दयावस्ततनन यादुषासः ||
7.88.e: Varuṇa placed Vasiṣṭha in the vessel, and deftly with his niight made him a Ṛṣi.  When days shone bright the Sage made him a singer, while the heavens broadened and the Dawns were lengthened.

7.88.d: कव तयानि नौ सख्या बभूवुः सचावहे यदव्र्कं पुरा चित | बर्हन्तं मानं वरुण सवधावः सहस्रद्वारं जगमा गर्हं ते ||
7.88.e: What hath become of those our ancient friendships, when without enmity we walked together?  I, Varuṇa, thou glorious Lord, have entered thy lofty home, thine house with thousand portals.

7.88.d: य आपिर्नित्यो वरुण परियः सन तवामागांसि कर्णवत सखा ते | मा त एनस्वन्तो यक्षिन भुजेम यन्धि षमा विप्र सतुवते वरूथम ||
7.88.e: If he, thy true ally, hath sinned against thee, still, Varuṇa, he is the friend thou lovedst.  Let us not, Living One, as sinners I know thee: give shelter, as a Sage, to him who lauds thee.

7.88.d: धरुवासु तवासु कषितिषु कषियन्तो वयस्मत पाशं वरुणोमुमोचत | अवो वन्वाना अदितेरुपस्थाद यूयं पात ||
7.88.e: While we abide in these fixed habitations, and from the lap of Aditi win favour,  May Varuṇa untie the bond that binds us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.89.d: मो षु वरुण मर्न्मयं गर्हं राजन्नहं गमम | मर्ळा सुक्षत्र मर्ळय ||
7.89.e: LET me not yet, King Varuṇa, enter into the house of clay:  Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

7.89.d: यदेमि परस्फुरन्निव दर्तिर्न धमातो अद्रिवः | मर्ळा स. म. ||
7.89.e: When, Thunderer! I move along tremulous like a wind-blown skin,  Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

7.89.d: करत्वः समह दीनता परतीपं जगमा शुचे | मर्ळा स. म. ||
7.89.e: O Bright and Powerful God, through want of strength I erred and went astray  Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

7.89.d: अपां मध्ये तस्थिवांसं तर्ष्णाविदज्जरितारम | मर्ळा स. म. ||
7.89.e: Thirst found thy worshipper though he stood in the midst of water-fijods:  Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

7.89.d: यत किं चेदं वरुण दैव्ये जने.अभिद्रोहं मनुष्याश्चरामसि | अचित्ती यत तव धर्मा युयोपिम मा नस्तस्मादेनसो देव रीरिषः ||
7.89.e: O Varuṇa, whatever the offence may be which we as men commit against the heavenly host,  When through our want of thought we violate thy laws, punish us not, O God, for that iniquity.

7.90.d: पर वीरया शुचयो दद्रिरे वामध्वर्युभिर्मधुमन्तः सुतासः | वह वायो नियुतो याह्यछा पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो मदाय ||
7.90.e: To you pure juice, rich in meath, are offered by priest: through longing for the Pair of Heroes.  Drive, Vāyu, bring thine harnessed horses hither: drink the pressed Soma till it make thee joyful.

7.90.d: ईशानाय परहुतिं यस्त आनट छुचिं सोमं शुचिपास्तुभ्यं वायो | कर्णोषि तं मर्त्येषु परशस्तं जातो-जातो जायते वाज्यस्य ||
7.90.e: Whoso to thee, the Mighty, brings oblation, pure Soma unto thee, pure-drinking Vāyu,  That man thou makest famous among mortals: to him strong sons are born in quick succession.

7.90.d: राये नु यं जज्ञतू रोदसीमे राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम | अध वायुं नियुतः सश्चत सवा उत शवेतं वसुधितिं निरेके ||
7.90.e: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhiṣaṇā for our wealth appointeth,  His team of harnessed horses waits on Vāyu, and, foremost, on the radiant Treasure-bearer.

7.90.d: उछन्नुषसः सुदिना अरिप्रा उरु जयोतिर्विविदुर्दीध्यानाः | गव्यं चिदूर्वमुशिजो वि वव्रुस्तेषामनु परदिवः सस्रुरापः ||
7.90.e: The spotless Dawns with fair bright days have broken; they found the spacious light when they were shining.  Eagerly they disclosed the stall of cattle: floods streamed for them as in the days aforetime.

7.90.d: ते सत्येन मनसा दीध्यानाः सवेन युक्तासः करतुना वहन्ति | इन्द्रवायू वीरवाहं रथं वामीशानयोरभि पर्क्षः सचन्ते ||
7.90.e: These with their truthful spirit, shining brightly, move on provided with their natural insight.  Viands attend the car that beareth Heroes, your car, ye Sovran Pair, Indra and Vāyu.

7.90.d: ईशानासो ये दधते सवर्णो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्हिरण्यैः | इन्द्रवायू सूरयो विश्वमायुरर्वद्भिर्वीरैः पर्तनासु सह्युः ||
7.90.e: May these who give us heavenly light, these rulers, with gifts of kine and horses, gold and treasures.  These princes, through full life, Indra and Vāyu! o’ercome in battle with their steeds and heroes.

7.90.d: अर्वन्तो न शरवसो भिक्षमाणा इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः | वाजयन्तः सववसे हुवेम यूयं पात ... ||
7.90.e: Like coursers seeking fame will we Vasisthas, O Indra-Vāyu, with our fair laudations.  Exerting all our power call you to aid us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.91.d: कुविदङग नमसा ये वर्धासः पुरा देवा अनवद्यास आसन | ते वायवे मनवे बाधितायावासयन्नुषसं सूर्येण ||
7.91.e: WERE not in sooth, the Gods aforetime blameless, whose pleasure was increased by adoration?  For Vāyu and for man in his affliction they caused the Morning to arise with Sūrya.

7.91.d: उशन्ता दूता न दभाय गोपा मासश्च पाथः शरदश्च पूर्वीः | इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिर्वामियाना मार्डीकमीट्टे सुवितं च नव्यम ||
7.91.e: Guardians infallible, eager as envoys' preserve us safe through many months and autumns.  Addressed to you, our fair praise, Indra-Vāyu, implores your favour and renewed well-being.

7.91.d: पीवोन्नान रयिव्र्धः सुमेधाः शवेतः सिषक्ति नियुतामभिश्रीः | ते वायवे समनसो वि तस्थुर्विश्वेन नरः सवपत्यानि चक्रुः ||
7.91.e: Wise, bright, arranger of his teams, he. seeketh men with rich food whose treasures are abundant.  They have arranged them of one mind with Vāyu: the men have wrought all noble operations.

7.91.d: यावत तरस्तन्वो यावदोजो यावन नरश्चक्षसा दीध्यानाः | शुचिं सोमं शुचिपा पातमस्मे इन्द्रवायू सदतम्बर्हिरेदम ||
7.91.e: So far as native power and strength permit you, so far as men behold whose eyes have vision,  O ye pure-drinkers, drink with us pure Soma: sit on this sacred grass, Indra and Vāyu.

7.91.d: नियुवाना नियुत सपार्हवीरा इन्द्रवि -मर्वाक | आू} इदं हि वां परभ्र्तं मध्वो अग्रमध परीणाना विमुमुक्तमस्मे ||
7.91.e: Driving down teams that bear the lovely Heroes, hitherward, Indra-Vāyu, come together.  To you this prime of savoury juice is offered: here loose your horses and be friendly-minded.

7.91.d: या वां शतं नियुतो याः सहस्रमिन्द्रवायू विश्ववाराः सचन्ते | आभिर्यातं सुविदत्राभिरर्वाक पातं नराप्रतिभ्र्तस्य मध्वः ||
7.91.e: Your hundred and your thousand teams, O Indra and Vāyu, all-munificent, which attend you,  With these most gracious-minded come ye hither, and drink, O Heroes of the meath we offer.
Like coursers seeking fame will we Vasisthas, O Indra-Vāyu, with our fair laudations,  Exerting all our powe-,, call you to aid us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.92.d: आ वायो भूष शुचिपा उप नः सहस्रं ते नियुतो विश्ववार | उपो ते अन्धो मद्यमयामि यस्य देव दधिषे पूर्वपेयम ||
7.92.e: O VĀYU, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, Allbounteous Giver.  To thee the rapture-bringing juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.

7.92.d: पर सोता जीरो अध्वरेष्वस्थात सोममिन्द्राय वायवे पिबध्यै | पर यद वां मध्वो अग्रियं भरन्त्यध्वर्यवो देवयन्तः शचीभिः ||
7.92.e: Prompt at the holy rites forth came the presser with Soma-draughts for Indra and for Vāyu,  When ministering priests with strong devotion bring to you Twain the first taste of the Soma.

7.92.d: पर याभिर्यासि दाश्वांसमछा नियुद्भिर्वायविष्टयेदुरोणे | नि नो रयिं सुभोजसं युवस्व नि वीरं गव्यमश्व्यं च राधः ||
7.92.e: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his home, O Viyu, to direct him,  Therewith send wealth: to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.

7.92.d: ये वायव इन्द्रमादनास आदेवासो नितोशनासो अर्यः | घनन्तो वर्त्राणि सूरिभिः षयाम सासह्वांसो युधा नर्भिरमित्रान ||
7.92.e: Near to the Gods and making Indra joyful, devout and ofFering precious gifts to Vāyu,  Allied with princes, smiting down the hostile, may we with heroes conquer foes in battle.

7.92.d: आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि यज्ञम | वायो अस्मिन सवने मादयस्व यूयं पात ... ||
7.92.e: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship.  Come, Vāyu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.93.d: शुचिं नु सतोमं नवजातमद्येन्द्राग्नी वर्त्रहणा जुषेथाम | उभा हि वां सुहवा जोहवीमि ता वाजं सद्य उशतेधेष्ठा ||
7.93.e: SLAYERS of enemies, Indra and Agni, accept this day our new-born pure laudation.  Again, again I call you prompt to listen, best to give quickly strength to him who craves it.

7.93.d: ता सानसी शवसाना हि भूतं साकंव्र्धा शवसा शूशुवांसा | कषयन्तौ रायो यवसस्य भूरेः पर्ङकतं वाजस्य सथविरस्य घर्ष्वेः ||
7.93.e: For ye were strong to gain, exceeding mighty, growing together, waxing in your vigour.  Lords of the pasture filled with ample riches, bestow upon us strength both fresh and lasting.

7.93.d: उपो ह यद विदथं वाजिनो गुर्धीभिर्विप्राः परमतिमिछमानाः | अर्वन्तो न काष्ठां नक्षमाणा इन्द्राग्नी जोहुवतो नरस्ते ||
7.93.e: Yea when the strong have entered our assembly, and singers seeking with their hymns your favour,  They are like steeds who come into the race-course, those men who call aloud on Indra-Agni.

7.93.d: गीर्भिर्विप्रः परमतिमिछमान ईट्टे रयिं यशसं पूर्वभाजम | इन्द्राग्नी वर्त्रहणा सुवज्रा पर नो नव्येभिस्तिरतं देष्णैः ||
7.93.e: The singer, seeking with his hymns your favour, begs splendid riches of their first possessor.  Further us with new bounties, Indra-Agni, armed with strong thunder, slayers of the foeman.

7.93.d: सं यन मही मिथती सपर्धमाने तनूरुचा शूरसाता यतैते | अदेवयुं विदथे देवयुभिः सत्रा हतं सोमसुता जनेन ||
7.93.e: When two great hosts, arrayed against each other, meet clothed with brightness, in the fierce encounter  Stand ye beside the godly, smite the godless; and still assist the men who press the Soma.

7.93.d: इमामु षु सोमसुतिमुप न एन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम | नू चिद धि परिमम्नाथे अस्माना वां शश्वद्भिर्वव्र्तीय वाजैः ||
7.93.e: To this our Soma-pressing, Indra-Agni, come ye prepared to show your loving-kindness,  For not at any time have ye despised us. So may I draw you with all strengthenings hither.

7.93.d: सो अग्न एना नमसा समिद्धो.अछा मित्रं वरुणमिन्द्रं वोचेः | यत सीमागश्चक्र्मा तत सु मर्ळ तदर्यमादितिःशिश्रथन्तु ||
7.93.e: So Agni, kindled mid this adoration, invite thou Mitra, Varuṇa, and Indra.  Forgive whatever sin we have committed may Aryaman and Aditi remove it.

7.93.d: एता अग्न आशुषाणास इष्टीर्युवोः सचाभ्यश्याम वाजान | मेन्द्रो नो विष्णुर्मरुतः परि खयन यूयं पात ... ||
7.93.e: While we accelerate these our sacrifices, may we win strength from both of you, O Agni:  Ne’er may the Maruts, Indra, Viṣṇu slight us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.94.d: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः | अभ्राद वर्ष्टिरिवाजनि ||
7.94.e: As rain from out the cloud, for you, Indra and Agni, from my soul  This noblest praise hath been produced.

7.94.d: शर्णुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः | ईशानापिप्यतं धियः ||
7.94.e: Do ye, O Indra-Agni, hear the singer's call: accept his songs.  Ye Rulers, grant his heart's desire.

7.94.d: मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये | मा नो रीरधतं निदे ||
7.94.e: Give us not up to poverty, ye Heroes, Indra-Agni, nor  To slander and reproach of men.

7.94.d: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बर्हत सुव्र्क्तिमेरयामहे | धिया धेना अवस्यवः ||
7.94.e: To Indra and to Agni we bring reverence, high and holy hymn,  And, craving help, softwords with prayer.

7.94.d: ता हि शश्वन्त ईळत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये | सबाधो वाजसातये ||
7.94.e: For all these holy singers here implore these Twain to succour them,  And priests that they may win them strength.

7.94.d: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः परयस्वन्तो हवामहे | मेधसाता सनिष्यवः ||
7.94.e: Eager to laudyou, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food,  Fain for success in sacrifice.

7.94.d: इन्द्राग्नी अवसा गतमस्मभ्यं चर्षणीसहा | मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ||
7.94.e: Indra and Agni, come to us with favour, ye who conquer men:  Let not the wicked master us.

7.94.d: मा कस्य नो अररुषो धूर्तिः परणं मर्त्यस्य | इन्द्राग्नीशर्म यछतम ||
7.94.e: At no time let the injurious blow of hostile mortal fall on us:  O Indra-Agni, shelter us.

7.94.d: गोमद धिरण्यवद वसु यद वामश्वावदीमहे | इन्द्राग्नीतद वनेमहि ||
7.94.e: Whatever wealth we crave of you, in gold, in cattle, or in steeds,  That, Indra-Agni, let us gain;

7.94.d: यत सोम आ सुते नर इन्द्राग्नी अजोहवुः | सप्तीवन्ता सपर्यवः ||
7.94.e: When heroes prompt in worship call Indra and Agni, Lords of steeds,  Beside the Soma juice effused.

7.94.d: उक्थेभिर्व्र्त्रहन्तमा या मन्दाना चिदा गिरा | आङगूषैराविवासतः ||
7.94.e: Call hither with the song and lauds those who best slay the foemen, those  Who take delight in hymns of praise.

7.94.d: ताविद दुःशंसं मर्त्यं दुर्विद्वांसं रक्षस्विनम | आभोगं हन्मना हतमुदधिं हन्मना हतम ||
7.94.e: Slay ye the wicked man whose thought is evil of the demon kind.  Slay him who stays the waters, slay the Serpent with your deadly dart.

7.95.d: पर कषोदसा धायसा सस्र एषा सरस्वती धरुणमायसी पूः | परबाबधाना रथ्येव याति विश्वा अपो महिना सिन्धुरन्याः ||
7.95.e: THIS stream Sarasvatī with fostering current comes forth, our sure defence, our fort of iron.  As on a car, the flood flows on, surpassing in majesty and might all other waters.

7.95.d: एकाचेतत सरस्वती नदीनां शुचिर्यती गिरिभ्य आ समुद्रात | रायश्चेतन्ती भुवनस्य भूरेर्घ्र्तं पयो दुदुहे नाहुषाय ||
7.95.e: Pure in her course from mountains to the ocean, alone of streams Sarasvatī hath listened.  Thinking of wealth and the great world of creatures, she poured for Nahuṣa her milk and fatness.

7.95.d: स वाव्र्धे नर्यो योषणासु वर्षा शिशुर्व्र्षभो यज्ञियासु | स वाजिनं मघवद्भ्यो दधाति वि सातये तन्वं माम्र्जीत ||
7.95.e: Friendly to man he grew among the women, a strong young Steer amid the Holy Ladies.  He gives the fleet steed to our wealthy princes, and decks their bodies for success in battle.

7.95.d: उत सया नः सरस्वती जुषाणोप शरवत सुभगा यज्णे अस्मिन | मितज्ञुभिर्नमस्यैरियाना राया युजा चिदुत्तरा सखिभ्यः ||
7.95.e: May this Sarasvatī be pleased and listen at this our sacrifice, auspicious Lady,  When we with reverence, on our knees, implore her close-knit to wealth, most kind to those she loveth.

7.95.d: इमा जुह्वाना युष्मदा नमोभिः परति सतोमं सरस्वति जुषस्व | तव शर्मन परियतमे दधाना उप सथेयाम शरणं न वर्क्षम ||
7.95.e: These offerings have ye made with adoration: say this, Sarasvatī, and accept our praises;  And, placing us under thy dear protection, may we approach thee, as a tree, for shelter.

7.95.d: अयमु ते सरस्वति वसिष्ठो दवाराव रतस्य सुभगे वयावः | वर्ध शुभ्रे सतुवते रासि वाजान यूयं पात ... ||
7.95.e: For thee, O Blest Sarasvatī, Vasiṣṭha hath here unbarred the doors d sacred Order.  Wax, Bright One, and give strength to him who lauds thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.96.d: बर्हदु गायिषे वचो.असुर्या नदीनाम | सरस्वतीमिन महयासुव्र्क्तिभिः सतोमैर्वसिष्ठ रोदसी ||
7.96.e: I SING a lofty song, for she is mightiest, most divine of Streams.  Sarasvatī will I exalt with hymns and lauds, and, O Vasiṣṭha, Heaven and Earth.

7.96.d: उभे यत ते महिना शुभ्रे अन्धसी अधिक्षियन्ति पूरवः | सा नो बोध्यवित्री मरुत्सखा चोद राधो मघोनाम ||
7.96.e: When in the fulness of their strength the Pūrus dwell, Beauteous One, on thy two grassy banks,  Favour us thou who hast the Maruts for thy friends: stir up the bounty of our chiefs.

7.96.d: भद्रमिद भद्रा कर्णवत सरस्वत्यकवारी चेतति वाजिनीवती | गर्णाना जमदग्निवत सतुवाना च वसिष्ठवत ||
7.96.e: So may Sarasvatī auspicious send good luck; she, rich in spoil, is never niggardly in thought,  When praised in jamadagni's way and lauded as Vasiṣṭha lauds.

7.96.d: जनीयन्तो नवग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः | सरस्वन्तं हवामहे ||
7.96.e: We call upon Sarasvān, as unmarried men who long for wives,  As liberal men who yearn for sons.

7.96.d: ये ते सरस्व ऊर्मयो मधुमन्तो घर्तश्चुतः | तेभिर्नो.अविता भव ||
7.96.e: Be thou our kind protector, O Sarasvān, with those waves of thine  Laden with sweets and dropping oil.

7.96.d: पीपिवांसं सरस्वत सतनं यो विश्वदर्षतः | भक्षीमहि परजामिषम ||
7.96.e: May we enjoy Sarasvān's breast, all-beautiful, that swells with streams,  May we gain food and progeny.

7.97.d: यज्ञे दिवो नर्षदने पर्थिव्या नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति | इन्द्राय यत्र सवनानि सुन्वे गमन मदाय परथमं वयश च ||
7.97.e: WHERE Heaven and Earth combine in men's assembly, and ttose who love the Gods delight in worship,  Where the libations are effused for Indra, may he come first to drink and make him stronger.

7.97.d: आ दैव्या वर्णीमहे ऽवांसि बर्हस्पतिर नो मह आ सखायः | यथा भवेम मीळ्हुषे अनागा यो नो दाता परावतः पितेव ||
7.97.e: We crave the heavenly grace of Gods to guard us-so may Bṛhaspati, O friends, exalt us-  That he, the Bounteous God, may find us sintess, who giveth from a distance like a father.

7.97.d: तम उ जयेष्ठं नमसा हविर्भिः सुशेवम बरह्मणस पतिं गर्णीषे | इन्द्रं शलोको महि दैव्यः सिषक्तु यो बरह्मणो देवक्र्तस्य राजा ||
7.97.e: That Brahmaṇaspati, most High and Gracious, I glorify with offerings and with homage.  May the great song of praise divine, reach Indra who is the King of prayer the Gods’ creation.

7.97.d: स आ नो योनिं सदतु परेष्ठो बर्हस्पतिर विश्ववारो यो अस्ति | कामो रायः सुवीर्यस्य तं दात पर्षन नो अति सश्चतो अरिष्टान ||
7.97.e: May that Bṛhaspati who brings all blessings, most dearly loved, be seated by our altar.  Heroes and wealth we crave; may he bestow them, and bear us safe beyond the men who vex us.

7.97.d: तम आ नो अर्कम अम्र्ताय जुष्टम इमे धासुर अम्र्तासः पुराजाः | शुचिक्रन्दं यजतम पस्त्य्र्नाम बर्हस्पतिम अनर्वाणं हुवेम ||
7.97.e: To us these Deathless Ones, erst born, have granted this laud of ours which gives the Immortal pleasure.  Let us invoke Bṛhaspati, the foeless, the clear-voiced God, the Holy One of households

7.97.d: तं शग्मासो अरुषासो अश्वा बर्हस्पतिं सहवाहो वहन्ति | सहश चिद यस्य नीलवत सधस्थं नभो न रूपम अरुषं वसानाः ||
7.97.e: Him, this Bṛhaspati, his red-hued horses, drawing together, full of strength, bring hither.  Robed in red colour like the cloud, they carry the Lord of Might whose friendship gives a dwelling.

7.97.d: स हि शुचिः शतपत्रः स शुन्ध्युर हिरण्यवाशीर इषिरः सवर्षाः | बर्हस्पतिः स सवावेश रष्वः पुरू सखिभ्य आसुतिं करिष्ठः ||
7.97.e: For he is pure, with hundred wings, refulgent, with sword of gold, impetuous, winning sunlight.  Sublime Bṛhaspati, easy of access granteth his friends most bountiful refreshment.

7.97.d: देवी देवस्य रोदसी जनित्री बर्हस्पतिं वाव्र्धतुर महित्वा | दक्षाय्याय दक्षता सखायः करद बरह्मणे सुतरा सुगाधा ||
7.97.e: Both Heaven and Earth, divine, the Deity's Parents, have made Bṛhaspati increase in grandeur.  Glorify him, O friends, who merits glory: may he give prayer fair way and easy passage.

7.97.d: इयं वाम बरह्मणस पते सुव्र्क्तिर बरह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे अकारि | अविष्टं धियो जिग्र्तम पुरंधीर जजस्तम अर्यो वनुषाम अरातीः ||
7.97.e: This, Brahmaṇaspati, is your laudation prayer hath been made to thunderwielding Indra.  Favour our songs, wake up our thought and spirit: destroy the godless and our foemen's malice.

7.97.d: बर्हस्पते युवम इन्द्रश च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य | धत्तं रयिं सतुवते कीरये चिद यूयम पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
7.97.e: Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Bṛhaspati, and thou, O Indra.  Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.98.d: अध्वर्यवो ऽरुणं दुग्धम अंशुं जुहोतन वर्षभाय कषितीनाम | गौराद वेदीयां अवपानम इन्द्रो विश्वाहेद याति सुतसोमम इछन ||
7.98.e: PRIESTS, offer to the Lord of all the people the milked-out stalk of Soma, radiant-coloured.  No wild-bull knows his drinking-place like Indra who ever seeks him who hath pressed the Soma,

7.98.d: यद दधिषे परदिवि चार्व अन्नं दिवे-दिवे पीतिम इद अस्य वक्षि | उत हर्दोत मनसा जुषाण उशन्न इन्द्र परस्थितान पाहि सोमान ||
7.98.e: Thou dost desire to drink, each day that passes, the pleasant food which thou hast had aforetime,  O Indra, gratified in heart and spirit, drink eagerly the Soma set before thee.

7.98.d: जज्ञानः सोमं सहसे पपाथ पर ते माता महिमानम उवाच | एन्द्र पप्राथोर्व अन्तरिक्षं युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश चकर्थ ||
7.98.e: Thou, newly-born, for strength didst drink the Soma; the Mother told thee of thy future greatness.  O Indra, thou hast filled mid-air's wide region, and given the Gods by battle room and freedom.

7.98.d: यद योधया महतो मन्यमानान साक्षाम तान बाहुभिः शाशदानान | यद वा नर्भिर वर्त इन्द्राभियुध्यास तं तवयाजिं सौश्रवसं जयेम ||
7.98.e: When thou hast urged the arrocrant to combat, proud in their strength of arm, we will subdue them.  Or, Indra, when thou fightest girt by heroes, we in the glorious fray with thee will conquer.

7.98.d: परेन्द्रस्य वोचम परथमा कर्तानि पर नूतना मघवा या चकार | यदेद अदेवीर असहिष्ट माया अथाभवत केवलः सोमो अस्य ||
7.98.e: I will declare the earliest deeds of Indra, and recent acts which Maghavan hath accomplished.  When he had conquered godless wiles and magic, Soma became his own entire possession.

7.98.d: तवेदं विश्वम अभितः पशव्यं यत पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य | गवाम असि गोपतिर एक इन्द्र भक्षीमहि ते परयतस्य वस्वः ||
7.98.e: Thine is this world of flocks and herds around thee, which with the eye of Sūrya thou beholdest.  Thou, Indra, art alone the Lord of cattle; may we enjoy the treasure which thou givest.

7.98.d: बर्हस्पते युवम इन्द्रश च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य | धत्तं रयिं सतुवते कीरये चिद यूयम पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
7.98.e: Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Bṛhaspati, and thou, O Indra.  Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.99.d: परो मात्रया तन्व्र वर्धान न ते महित्वम अन्व अश्नुवन्ति | उभे ते विद्म रजसी पर्थिव्या विष्णो देव तवम परमस्य वित्से ||
7.99.e: MEN come not nigh thy majesty who growest beyond all bound and measure with thy body.  Both thy two regions of the earth, O Viṣṇu, we know: thou God, knowest the highest also.

7.99.d: न ते विष्णो जायमानो न जातो देव महिम्नः परम अन्तम आप | उद अस्तभ्ना नाकम रष्वम बर्हन्तं दाधर्थ पराचीं ककुभम पर्थिव्याः ||
7.99.e: None who is born or being born, God Viṣṇu, hath reached the utmost limit of thy grandeur.  The vast high vault of heaven hast thou supported, and fixed earth's eastern pinnacle securely.

7.99.d: इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतं सूयवसिनी मनुषे दशस्या | वय अस्तभ्ना रोदसी विष्णव एते दाधर्थ पर्थिवीम अभितो मयूखैः ||
7.99.e: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fain to do men service.  Both these worlds, Viṣṇu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.

7.99.d: उरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुर उलोकं जनयन्ता सूर्यम उषासम अग्निम | दासस्य चिद वर्षशिप्रस्य माया जघ्नथुर नरा पर्तनाज्येषु ||
7.99.e: Ye have made spacious room for sacrificing by generating Sūrya, Dawn, and Agni.  O Heroes, ye have conquered in your battles even the bull-jawed Dāsa's wiles and magic.

7.99.d: इन्द्राविष्णू दरंहिताः शम्बरस्य नव पुरो नवतिं च शनथिष्टम | शतं वर्चिनः सहस्रं च साकं हथो अप्रत्य असुरस्य वीरान ||
7.99.e: Ye have destroyed, thou, Indra, and thou Viṣṇu, Śambara's nine-and-ninety fenced castles.  Ye Twain smote down a hundred times a thousand resistless heroes of the royal Varcin.

7.99.d: इयम मनीषा बर्हती बर्हन्तोरुक्रमा तवसा वर्धयन्ती | ररे वां सतोमं विदथेषु विष्णो पिन्वतम इषो वर्जनेष्व इन्द्र ||
7.99.e: This is the lofty hymn of praise, exalting the Lords of Mighty Stride, the strong and lofty.  I laud you in the solemn synods, Viṣṇu: pour ye food on us in our camps, O Indra.

7.99.d: वषट ते विष्णव आस आ कर्णोमि तन मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम | वर्धन्तु तवा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयम पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
7.99.e: O Viṣṇu, unto thee my lips cry Vaṣaṭ! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee.  May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.100.d: नू मर्तो दयते सनिष्यन यो विष्णव उरुगायाय दाशत | पर यः सत्राचा मनसा यजात एतावन्तं नर्यम आविवासात ||
7.100.e: NE’ER doth the man repent, who, seeking profit, bringeth his gift to the far-striding Viṣṇu.  He who adoreth him with all his spirit winneth himself so great a benefactor.

7.100.d: तवं विष्णो सुमतिं विश्वजन्याम अप्रयुताम एवयावो मतिं दाः | पर्चो यथा नः सुवितस्य भूरेर अश्वावतः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः ||
7.100.e: Thou, Viṣṇu, constant in thy courses, gavest good-will to all men, and a hymn that lasteth,  That thou mightst move us to abundant comfort of very splendid wealth with store of horses.

7.100.d: तरिर देवः पर्थिवीम एष एतां वि चक्रमे शतर्चसम महित्वा | पर विष्णुर अस्तु तवसस तवीयान तवेषं हय अस्य सथविरस्य नाम ||
7.100.e: Three times strode forth this God in all his grandeur over this earth bright with a hundred splendours.  Foremost be Viṣṇu, stronger than the strongest: for glorious is his name who lives for ever.

7.100.d: वि चक्रमे पर्थिवीम एष एतां कषेत्राय विष्णुर मनुषे दशस्यन | धरुवासो अस्य कीरयो जनास उरुक्षितिं सुजनिमा चकार ||
7.100.e: Over this earth with mighty step strode Viṣṇu, ready to give it for a home to Manu.  In him the humble people trust for safety: he, nobly born, hath made them spacious dwellings.

7.100.d: पर तत ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नामार्यः शंसामि वयुनानि विद्वान | तं तवा गर्णामि तवसम अतव्यान कषयन्तम अस्य रजसः पराके ||
7.100.e: To-day I laud this name, O gipivista, I, skilled in rules, the name of thee the Noble.  Yea, I the poor and weak praise thee the Mighty who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.

7.100.d: किम इत ते विष्णो परिचक्ष्यम भूत पर यद ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि | मा वर्पो अस्मद अप गूह एतद यद अन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ ||
7.100.e: What was there to be blamed in thee, O Viṣṇu, when thou declaredst, I am Sipivista?  Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.

7.100.d: वषट ते विष्णव आस आ कर्णोमि तन मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम | वर्धन्तु तवा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयम पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
7.100.e: O Viṣṇu, unto thee my lips cry Vaṣaṭ! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee.  May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.101.d: तिस्रो वाचः पर वद जयोतिरग्रा या एतद दुह्रे मधुदोघम ऊधः | स वत्सं कर्ण्वन गर्भम ओषधीनां सद्यो जातो वर्षभो रोरवीति ||
7.101.e: SPEAK forth three words, the words which light precedeth, which milk this udder that produceth nectar.  Quickly made manifest, the Bull hath bellowed, engendering the germ of plants, the Infant.

7.101.d: यो वर्धन ओषधीनां यो अपां यो विश्वस्य जगतो देव ईशे | स तरिधातु शरणं शर्म यंसत तरिवर्तु जयोतिः सवभिष्ट्य अस्मे ||
7.101.e: Giver of growth to plants, the God who ruleth over the waters and all moving creatures,  Vouchsafe us triple shelter for our refuge, and threefold light to succour and befriend us.

7.101.d: सतरीर उ तवद भवति सूत उ तवद यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः | पितुः पयः परति गर्भ्णाति माता तेन पिता वर्धते तेन पुत्रः ||
7.101.e: Now he is sterile, now begetteth offspring, even as he willeth doth he change his figure.  The Father's genial flow bedews the Mother; therewith the Sire, therewith the son is nourished.

7.101.d: यस्मिन विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुस तिस्रो दयावस तरेधा सस्रुर आपः | तरयः कोशास उपसेचनासो मध्व शचोतन्त्य अभितो विरप्शम ||
7.101.e: In him all living creatures have their being, and the three heavens with triply-flowing waters.  Three reservoirs that sprinkle down their treasure shed their sweet streams around him with a murmur.

7.101.d: इदं वचः पर्जन्याय सवराजे हर्दो अस्त्व अन्तरं तज जुजोषत | मयोभुवो वर्ष्टयः सन्त्व अस्मे सुपिप्पला ओषधीर देवगोपाः ||
7.101.e: May this my song to Sovran Lord Parjanya come near unto his heart and give him pleasure.  May we obtain the showers that bring enjoyment, and God-protected plants with goodly fruitage.

7.101.d: स रेतोधा वर्षभः शश्वतीनां तस्मिन्न आत्मा जगतस तस्थुषश च | तन म रतम पातु शतशारदाय यूयम पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
7.101.e: He is the Bull of all, and their impregner: he holds the life of all things fixed and moving.  May this rite save me till my hundredth autumn. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

7.102.d: पर्जन्याय पर गायत दिवस पुत्राय मीळ्हुषे | स नो यवसमिछतु ||
7.102.e: SING forth and laud Parjanya, son of Heaven, who sends the gift of rain  May he provide our pasturage.
Parjanya is the God who forms in kine, in mares, in plants of earth,  And womankind, the germ of life.

7.102.d: तस्मा इदास्ये हविर्जुहोता मधुमत्तमम | इळां नः संयतं करत ||
7.102.e: Offer and pour into his mouth oblation rich in savoury juice:  May he for ever give us food.

7.103.d: संवत्सरं शशयाना बराह्मणा वरतचारिणः | वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां पर मण्डूका अवादिषुः ||
7.103.e: THEY who lay quiet for a year, the Brahmans who fulfil their vows,  The Frogs have lifted up their voice, the voice Parjanya hath inspired.

7.103.d: दिव्या आपो अभि यदेनमायन दर्तिं न शुष्कं सरसी शयानम | गवामह न मायुर्वत्सिनीनां मण्दूकानां वग्नुरत्रा समेति ||
7.103.e: What time on these, as on a dry skin lying in the pool's bed, the floods of heaven descended,  The music of the Frogs comes forth in concert like the cows lowing with their calves beside them.

7.103.d: यदीमेनानुशतो अभ्यवर्षीत तर्ष्यावतः पराव्र्ष्यागतायाम | अख्खलीक्र्त्या पितरं न पुत्रो अन्यो अन्यमुप वदन्तमेति ||
7.103.e: When at the coming of the Rains the water has poured upon them as they yearned and thirsted,  One seeks another as he talks and greets him with cries of pleasure as a son his father.

7.103.d: अन्यो अन्यमनु गर्भ्णात्येनोरपां परसर्गे यदमन्दिषाताम | मण्डूको यदभिव्र्ष्टः कनिष्कन पर्ष्निः सम्प्र्ङकते हरितेन वाचम ||
7.103.e: Each of these twain receives the other kindly, while they are revelling in the flow of waters,  When the Frog moistened by the rain springs forward, and Green and Spotty both combine their voices.

7.103.d: यदेषामन्यो अन्यस्य वाचं शाक्तस्येव वदति शिक्षमाणः | सर्वं तदेषां सम्र्धेव पर्व यत सुवाचो वदथनाध्यप्सु ||
7.103.e: When one of these repeats the other's language, as he who learns the lesson of the teacher,  Your every limb seems to be growing larger as ye converse with eloquence on the waters.

7.103.d: गोमायुरेको अजमायुरेकः पर्श्निरेको हरित एक एषाम | समानं नाम बिभ्रतो विरूपाः पुरुत्रा वाचं पिपिशुर्वदन्तः ||
7.103.e: Onc is Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat the other, one Frog is Green and one of them is Spotty.  They bear one common name, and yet they vary, and, talking, modulate the voice diversely.

7.103.d: बराह्मणासो अतिरात्रे न सोमे सरो न पूर्णमभितो वदन्तः | संवत्सरस्य तदहः परि षठ यन मण्डूकाः पराव्र्षीणं बभूव ||
7.103.e: As Brahmans, sitting round the brimful vessel, talk at the Soma-rite of Atiratra,  So, Frogs, ye gather round the pool to honour this day of all the year, the first of Rain-time.

7.103.d: बराह्मणासः सोमिनो वाचमक्रत बरह्म कर्ण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम | अध्वर्यवो घर्मिणः सिष्विदाना आविर्भवन्ति गुह्या न के चित ||
7.103.e: These Brahmans with the Soma juice, performing their year-long rite, have lifted up their voices;  And these Adhvaryus, sweating with their kettles, come forth and show themselves, and none are hidden.

7.103.d: देवहितिं जुगुपुर्द्वादशस्य रतुं नरो न पर मिनन्त्येते | संवत्सरे पराव्र्ष्यागतायां तप्ता घर्मा अश्नुवते विसर्गम ||
7.103.e: They keep the twelve month's God-appointed order, and never do the men neglect the season.  Soon as the Rain-time in the year returneth, these who were heated kettles gain their freedom.

7.103.d: गोमायुरदादजमायुरदात पर्श्निरदाद धरितो नो वसूनि | गवां मण्डूका ददतः शतानि सहस्रसावे पर तिरन्त आयुः ||
7.103.e: Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat have granted riches, and Green and Spotty have vouchsafed us treasure.  The Frogs who give us cows in hundreds lengthen our lives in this most fertilizing season.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा तपतं रक्ष उब्जतं नयर्पयतं वर्षणा तमोव्र्धः | परा सर्णीतमचितो नयोषतं हतं नुदेथां नि शिशीतमत्रिणः ||
7.104.e: INDRA and Soma, burn, destroy the demon foe, send downward, O ye Bulls, those who add gloom to gloom.  Annihilate the fools, slay them and burn them up: chase them away from us, pierce the voracious ones.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा समघशंसमभ्यघं तपुर्ययस्तु चरुरग्निवानिव | बरह्मद्विषे करव्यादे घोरचक्षसे दवेषो धत्तमनवायं किमीदिने ||
7.104.e: Indra and Soma, let sin round the wicked boil like as a caldron set amid the flames of fire.  Against the foe of prayer, devourer of raw flesh, the vile fiend fierce of eye, keep ye perpetual hate.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा दुष्क्र्तो वव्रे अन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि पर विध्यतम | यथा नातः पुनरेकश्चनोदयत तद वामस्तु सहसे मन्युमच्छवः ||
7.104.e: Indra and Soma, plunge the wicked in the depth, yea, cast them into darkness that hath no support,  So that not one of them may ever thence return: so may your wrathful might prevail and conquer them.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवो वधं सं पर्थिव्या अघशंसाय तर्हणम | उत तक्षतं सवर्यं पर्वतेभ्यो येन रक्षो वाव्र्धानं निजूर्वथः ||
7.104.e: Indra and Soma, hurl your deadly crushing bolt down on the wicked fiend from heaven and from the earth.  Yea, forge out of the mountains your celestial dart wherewith ye burn to death the waxing demon race.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवस पर्यग्नितप्तेभिर्युवमश्महन्मभिः | तपुर्वधेभिरजरेभिरत्रिणो नि पर्शाने विध्यतं यन्तु निस्वरम ||
7.104.e: Indra and Soma, cast ye downward out of heaven your deadly darts of stone burning with fiery flame,  Eternal, scorching darts; plunge the voracious ones within the depth, and let them sink without a sound.

7.104.d: इन्द्रासोमा परि वां भूतु विश्वत इयं मतिः कक्ष्याश्वेववाजिना | यां वां होत्रां परिहिनोमि मेधयेमा बरह्माणि नर्पतीव जिन्वतम ||
7.104.e: Indra and Soma, let this hymn control you both, even as the girth encompasses two vigorous steeds-  The song of praise which I with wisdom offer you: do ye, as Lords of men, animate these my prayers.

7.104.d: परति समरेथां तुजयद्भिरेवैर्हतं दरुहो रक्षसो भङगुरावतः | इन्द्रासोमा दुष्क्र्ते मा सुगं भूद यो नः कदाचिदभिदासति दरुहा ||
7.104.e: In your impetuous manner think ye both thereon: destroy these evil beings, slay the treacherous fiends.  Indra and Soma, let the wicked have no bliss who evermore assails us with malignity.

7.104.d: यो मा पाकेन मनसा चरन्तमभिचष्टे अन्र्तेभिर्वचोभिः | आप इव काशिना संग्र्भीता असन्नस्त्वासत इन्द्र वक्ता ||
7.104.e: Whoso accuses me with words of falsehood when I pursue my way with guileless spirit,  May he, the speaker of untruth, be, Indra, like water which the hollowed hand compresses.

7.104.d: ये पाकशंसं विहरन्त एवैर्ये वा भद्रं दूषयन्ति सवधाभिः | अहये वा तान परददातु सोम आ वा दधातु निरतेरुपस्थे ||
7.104.e: Those who destroy, as is their wont, the simple, and with their evil natures barm the righteous,  May Soma give them over to the serpent, or to the lap of Nirrti consign them.

7.104.d: यो नो रसं दिप्सति पित्वो अग्ने यो अश्वानां यो गवां यस्तनूनाम | रिपु सतेन सतेयक्र्द दभ्रमेतु नि ष हीयतान्तन्वा तना च ||
7.104.e: The fiend, O Agni, who designs to injure the essence of our food, kine, steeds, or bodies,  May he, the adversary, thief, and robber, sink to destruction, both himself and offipring.

7.104.d: परः सो अस्तु तन्वा तना च तिस्रः पर्थिवीरधो अस्तु विश्वाः | परति शुष्यतु यशो अस्य देवा यो नो दिवा दिप्सति यश्च नक्तम ||
7.104.e: May he be swept away, himself and children: may all the three earths press him down beneath them.  May his fair glory, O ye Gods, be blighted, who in the day or night would fain destroy us.

7.104.d: सुविज्ञानं चिकितुषे जनाय सच्चासच्च वचसी पस्प्र्धाते | तयोर्यत सत्यं यतरद रजीयस्तदित सोमो.अवति हन्त्यासत ||
7.104.e: The prudent finds it easy to distinguish the true and false: their words oppose each other.  Of these two that which is the true and honest, Soma protects, and brings the false to nothing.

7.104.d: ना वा उ सोमो वर्जिनं हिनोति न कषत्रियं मिथुया धारयन्तम | हन्ति रक्षो हन्त्यासद वदन्तमुभाविन्द्रस्य परसितौ शयाते ||
7.104.e: Never doth Soma aid and guide the wicked or him who falsely claims the Warrior's title.  He slays the fiend and him who speaks untruly: both lie entangled in the noose of Indra.

7.104.d: यदि वाहमन्र्तदेव आस मोघं वा देवानप्यूहे अग्ने | किमस्मभ्यं जातवेदो हर्णीषे दरोघवाचस्ते निरथं सचन्ताम ||
7.104.e: As if I worshipped deities of falsehood, or thought vain thoughts about the Gods, O Agni.  Why art thou angry with us, Jātavedas? Destruction fall on those who lie against thee!

7.104.d: अद्या मुरीय यदि यातुधानो अस्मि यदि वायुस्ततप पूरुषस्य | अधा स वीरैर्दशभिर्वि यूया यो मा मोघं यातुधानेत्याह ||
7.104.e: So may I die this day if I have harassed any man's life or if I be a demon.  Yea, may he lose all his ten sons together who with false tongue hath called me Yātudhāna.

7.104.d: यो मायातुं यातुधानेत्याह यो वा रक्षाः शुचिरस्मीत्याह | इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेन विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमस पदीष्ट ||
7.104.e: May Indra slay him with a mighty weapon, and let the vilest of all creatures perish,  The fiend who says that he is pure, who calls me a demon though devoid of demon nature.

7.104.d: पर या जिगाति खर्गलेव नक्तमप दरुहा तन्वं गूहमाना | वव्राननन्तानव सा पदीष्ट गरावाणो घनन्तु रक्षस उपब्दैः ||
7.104.e: She too who wanders like an owl at night-time, hiding her body in her guile and malice,  May she fall downward into endless caverns. May press-stones with loud ring destroy the demons.

7.104.d: वि तिष्ठध्वं मरुतो विक्ष्विछत गर्भायत रक्षसः सं पिनष्टन | वयो ये भूत्वी पतयन्ति नक्तभिर्ये वा रिपो दधिरे देवे अध्वरे ||
7.104.e: Spread out, ye Maruts, search among the people: seize ye and grind the Rākṣasas to pieces,  Who fly abroad, transformed to birds, at night-time, or sully and pollute our holy worship.

7.104.d: पर वर्तय दिवो अश्मानमिन्द्र सोमशितं मघवन सं शिशाधि | पराक्तादपाक्तादधरादुदक्तादभि जहि रक्षसःपर्वतेन ||
7.104.e: Hurl down from heaven thy bolt of stone, O Indra: sharpen it, Maghavan, made keen by Soma.  Forward, behind, and from above and under, smite down the demons with thy rocky weapon.

7.104.d: एत उ तये पतयन्ति शवयातव इन्द्रं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो.अदाभ्यम | शिशीते शक्रः पिशुनेभ्यो वधं नूनं सर्जदशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ||
7.104.e: They fly, the demon dogs, and, bent on mischief, fain would they harm indomitable Indra.  Śakra makes sharp his weapon for the wicked: now, let him cast his bolt at fiendish wizards.

7.104.d: इन्द्रो यातूनामभवत पराशरो हविर्मथीनामभ्याविवासताम | अभीदु शक्रः परशुर्यथा वनं पात्रेव भिन्दन सत एति रक्षसः ||
7.104.e: Indra hath ever been the fiends’ destroyer who spoil oblations of the Gods’ invokers:  Yea, Śakra, like an axe that  splits  the timber, attacks and smashes them like earthen vessels.

7.104.d: उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुं जहि शवयातुमुत कोकयातुम | सुपर्णयातुमुत गर्ध्रयातुं दर्षदेव पर मर्ण रक्ष इन्द्र ||
7.104.e: Destroy the fiend shaped like an owl or owlet, destroy him in the form of dog or cuckoo.  Destroy him shaped as eagle or as vulture as with a stone, O Indra, crush the demon.

7.104.d: मा नो रक्षो अभि नड यातुमावतामपोछतु मिथुना या किमीदिना | पर्थिवी नः पार्थिवात पात्वंहसो.अन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात पात्वस्मान ||
7.104.e: Let not the fiend of witchcraft-workers reach us: may Dawn drive off the couples of Kimīdins.  Earth keep us safe from earthly woe and trouble: from grief that comes from heaven mid-air preserve us.

7.104.d: इन्द्र जहि पुमांसं यातुधानमुत सत्रियं मायया शाशदानाम | विग्रीवासो मूरदेवा रदन्तु मा ते दर्शं सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम ||
7.104.e: Slay the male demon, Indra! slay the female, joying and triumphing in arts of magic.  Let the fools' gods with bent necks fall and perish, and see no more the Sun when he arises.

7.104.d: परति चक्ष्व वि चक्ष्वेन्द्रश्च सोम जाग्र्तम | रक्षोभ्यो वधमस्यतमशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ||
7.104.e: Look each one hither, look around Indra and Soma, watch ye well.

8.1.d: मा चिदन्यद वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत | इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वर्षणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत ||
8.1.e: GLORIFY naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you.  Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly:

8.1.d: अवक्रक्षिणं वर्षभं यथाजुरं गां न चर्षणीसहम | विद्वेषणं संवननोभयंकरं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनम ||
8.1.e: Even him, eternal, like a bull who rushes down, men's Conqueror, bounteous like a cow;  Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.

8.1.d: यच्चिद धि तवा जना इमे नाना हवन्त ऊतये | अस्माकं बरह्मेदमिन्द्र भूतु ते.अह विश्वा च वर्धनम ||
8.1.e: Although these men in sundry ways invoke thee to obtain thine aid,  Be this our prayer, addressed, O Indra, unto thee, thine exaltation every day.

8.1.d: वि तर्तूर्यन्ते मघवन विपश्चितो.अर्यो विपो जनानाम | उप करमस्व पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ||
8.1.e: Those skilled in song, O Maghavan among these men o’ercome with might the foeman's songs.  Come hither, bring us strength in many a varied form most near that it may succour us.

8.1.d: महे चन तवामद्रिवः परा शुल्काय देयाम | न सहस्रायनायुताय वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ ||
8.1.e: O Caster of the Stone, I would not sell thee for a mighty price,  Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!

8.1.d: वस्यानिन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भरातुरभुञ्जतः | माता चमे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे ||
8.1.e: O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is.  Thou and my mother, O Good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.

8.1.d: कवेयथ कवेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद धि ते मनः | अलर्षि युध्म खजक्र्त पुरन्दर पर गायत्रा अगासिषुः ||
8.1.e: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind.  Haste, Warrior, Fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din, haste, holy songs have sounded forth.

8.1.d: परास्मै गायत्रमर्चत वावातुर्यः पुरन्दरः | याभिःकाण्वस्योप बर्हिरासदं यासद वज्री भिनत पुरः ||
8.1.e: Sing out the psalm to him who breaks down castles for his faithful friend,  Verses to bring the Thunderer to destroy the forts and sit on Kaṇva's sacred grass.

8.1.d: ये ते सन्ति दशग्विनः शतिनो ये सहस्रिणः | अश्वासो येते वर्षणो रघुद्रुवस्तेभिर्नस्तूयमा गहि ||
8.1.e: The Horses which are thine in tens, in hundreds, yea, in thousands thine,  Even those vigorous Steeds, fleet-footed in the course, with those come quickly near to us.

8.1.d: आ तवद्य सबर्दुघां हुवे गायत्रवेपसम | इन्द्रं धेनुंसुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरंक्र्तम ||
8.1.e: This day I call Sabardughā who animates the holy song,  Indra the richly-yielding Milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.

8.1.d: यत तुदत सूर एतशं वङकू वातस्य पर्णिना | वहत कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतुः तसरद गन्धर्वमस्त्र्तम ||
8.1.e: When Sūra wounded Etaśa, with Vāta's rolling winged car.  Indra bore Kutsa Ārjuneya off, and mocked Gandharva. the unconquered One.

8.1.d: य रते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आत्र्दः | सन्धातासन्धिं मघवा पुरूवसुरिष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ||
8.1.e: He without ligature, before making incision in the neck,  Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who maketh whole the injured part.

8.1.d: मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र तवदरणा इव | वनानि न परजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि ||
8.1.e: May we be never cast aside, and strangers, as it were, to thee.  We, Thunder-wielding Indra, count ourselves as trees rejected and unfit to burn.

8.1.d: अमन्महीदनाशवो.अनुग्रासश्च वर्त्रहन | सक्र्त सु ते महता शूर राधसानु सतोमं मुदीमहि ||
8.1.e: O Vṛtra-slayer, we were thought slow and unready for the fray.  Yet once in thy great bounty may we have delight, O Hero, after praising thee.

8.1.d: यदि सतोमं मम शरवदस्माकमिन्द्रमिन्दवः | तिरः पवित्रं सस्र्वांस आशवो मन्दन्तु तुग्र्याव्र्धः ||
8.1.e: If he will listen to my laud, then may out Soma-drops that flow  Rapidly through the strainer gladden Indra, drops due to the Tugryas’ Strengthener.

8.1.d: आ तवद्य सधस्तुतिं वावातुः सख्युरा गहि | उपस्तुतिर्मघोनां पर तवावत्वधा ते वश्मि सुष्टुतिम ||
8.1.e: Come now unto the common laud of thee and of thy faithful friend.  So may our wealthy nobles’ praise give joy to thee. Fain would I sing thine eulogy.

8.1.d: सोता हि सोममद्रिभिरेमेनमप्सु धावत | गव्या वस्त्रेव वासयन्त इन नरो निर्धुक्षन वक्षणाभ्यः ||
8.1.e: Press out the Soma with the stones, and in the waters wash it clean.  The men investing it with raiment made of milk shall milk it forth from out the stems.

8.1.d: अध जमो अध वा दिवो बर्हतो रोचनादधि | अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पर्ण ||
8.1.e: Whether thou come from earth or from the lustre of the lofty heaven,  Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most Wise.

8.1.d: इन्द्राय सु मदिन्तमं सोमं सोता वरेण्यम | शक्र एणं पीपयद विश्वया धिया हिन्वानं न वाजयुम ||
8.1.e: For India press the Soma out, most gladdening and most excellent.  May Śakra make it swell sent forth with every prayer and asking, as it were, for strength.

8.1.d: मा तवा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं गिरा | भूर्णिं मर्गं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत ||
8.1.e: Let me not, still beseeching thee with earnest song at Soma rites,  Anger thee like  some  wild beast. Who would not beseech him who hath power to grant his prayer?

8.1.d: मदेनेषितं मदमुग्रमुग्रेण शवसा | विश्वेषां तरुतारं मदच्युतं मदे हि षमा ददाति नः ||
8.1.e: The draught made swift with rapturous joy, effectual with its mighty strength,  All-conquering, distilling transport, let him drink: for he in ecstasy gives us gifts.

8.1.d: शेवारे वार्या पुरु देवो मर्ताय दाशुषे | स सुन्वते चस्तुवते च रासते विश्वगूर्तो अरिष्टुतः ||
8.1.e: Where bliss is not, may he, All-praised, God whom the pious glorify,  Bestow great wealth upon the mortal worshipper who sheds the juice and praises him.

8.1.d: एन्द्र याहि मत्स्व चित्रेण देव राधसा | सरो न परास्युदरं सपीतिभिरा सोमेभिरुरु सफिरम ||
8.1.e: Come, Indra, and rejoice thyself, O God, in manifold affluence.  Thou fillest like a lake thy vast capacious bulk with Soma and with draughts besides.

8.1.d: आ तवा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये | बरह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ||
8.1.e: A thousand and a hundred Steeds are harnessed to thy golden car.  So may the long-maned Bays, yoked by devotion, bring Indra to drink the Soma juice.

8.1.d: आ तवा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या | शितिप्र्ष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ||
8.1.e: Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two Bays with peacock tails,  Convey thee hither, Steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent.

8.1.d: पिबा तवस्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव | परिष्क्र्तस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ||
8.1.e: So drink, thou Lover of the Song, as the first drinker, of this juice.  This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee.

8.1.d: य एको अस्ति दंसना महानुग्रो अभि वरतैः | गमत स शिप्री न स योषदा गमद धवं न परि वर्जति ||
8.1.e: He who alone by wondrous deed is Mighty, Strong by holy works,  May he come, fair of cheek; may he not stay afar, but come and turn not from our call.

8.1.d: तवं पुरं चरिष्ण्वं वधैः शुष्णस्य सं पिणक | तवम्भा अनु चरो अध दविता यदिन्द्र हव्यो भुवः ||
8.1.e: Śuṣṇa's quick moving castle thou hast crushed to pieces with thy bolts.  Thou, Indra, from of old, hast followed after light, since we have had thee to invoke.

8.1.d: मम तवा सूर उदिते मम मध्यन्दिने दिवः | मम परपित्वेपिशर्वरे वसवा सतोमासो अव्र्त्सत ||
8.1.e: My praises when the Sun hath risen, my praises at the time of noon,  My praises at the coming of the gloom of night, O Vasu, have gone forth to thee.

8.1.d: सतुहि सतुहीदेते घा ते मंहिष्ठासो मघोनाम | निन्दिताश्वः परपथी परमज्या मघस्य मेध्यातिथे ||
8.1.e: Praise yea, praise him. Of princes these are the most liberal of their gifts,  These, Paramajyā, Ninditāśva, Prapathī, most bounteous, O Medhyātithi.

8.1.d: आ यदश्वान वनन्वतः शरद्धयाहं रथे रुहम | उतवामस्य वसुनश्चिकेतति यो अस्ति याद्वः पशुः ||
8.1.e: When to the car, by faith, I yoked the horses longing for the way-  For skilled is Yadu's son in dealing precious wealth, he who is rich in herds of kine.

8.1.d: य रज्रा मह्यं मामहे सह तवचा हिरण्यया | एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु सौभगासङगस्य सवनद्रथः ||
8.1.e: May he who gave me two brown steeds together with their cloths of gold,  May he, Āsaṅga's son Svanadratha, obtain all joy and high felicities.

8.1.d: अध पलायोगिरति दासदन्यानासङगो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैः | अधोक्षणो दश मह्यं रुशन्तो नळा इव सरसो निरतिष्ठन ||
8.1.e: Playoga's son Āsaṅga, by ten thousand, O Agni, hath surpassed the rest in giving.  For me ten bright-hued oxen have come forward like lotus-stalks from out a lake upstanding.

8.1.d: अन्वस्य सथूरं दद्र्शे पुरस्तादनस्थ ऊरुरवरम्बमाणः | शश्वती नार्यभिचक्ष्याह सुभद्रमर्य भोजनं बिभर्षि ||
8.1.e: What time her husband's perfect restoration to his lost strength and manhood was apparent,  His consort Śaśvatī with joy addressed him, Now art thou well, my lord, and shalt be happy.

8.2.d: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम | अनाभयिन ररिमा ते ||
8.2.e: HERE is the Soma juice expressed; O Vasu, drink till thou art full:  Undaunted God, we give it thee.

8.2.d: नर्भिर्धूतः सुतो अश्नैरव्यो वारैः परिपूतः | अश्वोन निक्तो नदीषु ||
8.2.e: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool,  ’Tis like a courser bathed in stream.

8.2.d: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः सवादुमकर्म शरीणन्तः | इन्द्र तवास्मिन सधमादे ||
8.2.e: This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk.  Indra, I call thee to our feast.

8.2.d: इन्द्र इत सोमपा एक इन्द्रः सुतपा विश्वायुः | अन्तर्देवान मर्त्यांश्च ||
8.2.e: Beloved of all, Indra alone drinks up the flowing Soma juice  Among the Gods and mortal men.

8.2.d: न यं शुक्रो न दुराशीर्न तर्प्रा उरुव्यचसम | अपस्प्र्ण्वते सुहार्दम ||
8.2.e: The Friend, whom not the brilliant-hued, the badly-mixt or bitter draught,  Repels, the far-extending God;

8.2.d: गोभिर्यदीमन्ये अस्मन मर्गं न वरा मर्गयन्ते | अभित्सरन्ति धेनुभिः ||
8.2.e: While other men than we with milk chase him as hunters chase a deer,  And with their kine inveigle him.

8.2.d: तरय इन्द्रस्य सोमाः सुतासः सन्तु देवस्य | सवे कषये सुतपाव्नः ||
8.2.e: For him, for Indra, for the God, be pressed three draughts of Soma juice  In the juice-drinker's own abode.

8.2.d: तरयः कोशासः शचोतन्ति तिस्रश्चम्वः सुपूर्णाः | समाने अधि भार्मन ||
8.2.e: Three reservoirs exude their drops, filled are three beakers to the brim,  All for one offering to the God.

8.2.d: शुचिरसि पुरुनिष्ठाः कषीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्तः | दध्ना मन्दिष्ठः शूरस्य ||
8.2.e: Pure art thou, set in many a place, and blended in the midst with milk  And curd, to cheer the Hero best.

8.2.d: इमे त इन्द्र सोमास्तीव्रा अस्मे सुतासः | शुक्रा आशिरंयाचन्ते ||
8.2.e: Here, Indra, are thy Soma-draughts pressed out by us, the strong, the pure:  They crave admixture of the milk.

8.2.d: तानाशिरं पुरोळाशमिन्द्रेमं सोमं शरीणीहि | रेवन्तं हि तवा शर्णोमि ||
8.2.e: O Indra, pour in milk, prepare the cake, and mix the Soma-draught.  I hear them say that thou art rich.

8.2.d: हर्त्सु पीतासो युध्यन्ते दुर्मदासो न सुरायाम | ऊधर्न नग्ना जरन्ते ||
8.2.e: Quaffed juices fight within the breast. The drunken praise not by their wine,  The naked praise not when it rains.

8.2.d: रेवानिद रेवत सतोता सयात तवावतो मघोनः | परेदु हरिवः शरुतस्य ||
8.2.e: Rich be the praiser of one rich, munificent and famed like thee:  High rank be his, O Lord of Bays.

8.2.d: उक्थं चन शस्यमानमगोररिरा चिकेत | न गायत्रंगीयमानम ||
8.2.e: Foe of the man who adds no milk, he heeds not any chanted hymn  Or holy psalm that may he sung.

8.2.d: मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः | शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ||
8.2.e: Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud:  Help, Mighty One, with power and might.

8.2.d: वयमु तवा तदिदर्था इन्द्र तवायन्तः सखायः | कण्वाुक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ||
8.2.e: This, even this, O Indra, we implore. as thy devoted friends,  The Kaṇvas praise thee with their hymns.

8.2.d: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ | तवेदु सतोमं चिकेत ||
8.2.e: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy:  On thy land only have I thought.

8.2.d: इछन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न सवप्नाय सप्र्हयन्ति | यन्ति परमादमतन्द्राः ||
8.2.e: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep  They punish sloth unweariedly.

8.2.d: ओ षु पर याहि वाजेभिर्मा हर्णीथा अभ्यस्मान | महानिव युवजानिः ||
8.2.e: Come hither swift with gifts of wealth - be not thou angry with us-like  A great man with a youthful bride.

8.2.d: मो षवद्य दुर्हणावान सायं करदारे अस्मत | अश्रीर इव जामाता ||
8.2.e: Let him not, wrathful with us, spend the evening far from us to-day,  Like some unpleasant son-in-law.

8.2.d: विद्मा हयस्य वीरस्य भूरिदावरीं सुमतिम | तरिषु जातस्य मनांसि ||
8.2.e: For well we know this Hero's love, most liberal of the boons he gives,  His plans whom the three worlds display.

8.2.d: आ तू षिञ्च कण्वमन्तं न घा विद्म शवसानात | यशस्तरं शतमूतेः ||
8.2.e: Pour forth the gift which Kaṇvas bring, for none more glorious do we know  Than the Strong Lord with countless aids.

8.2.d: जयेष्ठेन सोतरिन्द्राय सोमं वीराय शक्राय | भरा पिबन नर्याय ||
8.2.e: O presser, offer Soma first to Indra, Hero, Śakra, him  The Friend of man, that he may drink;

8.2.d: यो वेदिष्ठो अव्यथिष्वश्वावन्तं जरित्र्भ्यः | वाजं सतोत्र्भ्यो गोमन्तम ||
8.2.e: Who, in untroubled ways, is best provider, for his worshippers.  Of strength in horses and in kine.

8.2.d: पन्यम-पन्यमित सोतार आ धावत मद्याय | सोमं वीरय शूरय ||
8.2.e: Pressers, for him blend Soma juice, each draught most excellent, for him  The Brave, the Hero, for his joy.

8.2.d: पाता वर्त्रहा सुतमा घा गमन नारे अस्मत | नि यमते शतमूतिः ||
8.2.e: The Vṛtra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids  Approach, nor stay afar from us.

8.2.d: एह हरी बरह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम | गीर्भिःश्रुतं गिर्वणसम ||
8.2.e: May the strong Bay Steeds, yoked by prayer, bring hither unto us our Friend,  Lover of Song, renowned by songs.

8.2.d: सवादवः सोमा आ याहि शरीताः सोमा आ याहि | शिप्रिन्न्र्षीवः शचीवो नायमछा सधमादम ||
8.2.e: Sweet are the Soma juices, come! Blent are the Soma juices, come!  Ṛṣi-like, mighty, fair of cheek, come hither quickly to the feast.

8.2.d: सतुतश्च यास्त्वा वर्धन्ति महे राधसे नर्म्णाय | इन्द्रकारिणं वर्धन्तः ||
8.2.e: And lauds which strengthen thee for great bounty and valour, and exalt  Indra who doeth glorious deeds,

8.2.d: गिरश्च यास्ते गिर्वाह उक्था च तुभ्यं तानि | सत्रा दधिरे शवांसि ||
8.2.e: And songs to thee who lovest song, and all those hymns addressed to thee-  These evermore confirm thy might.

8.2.d: एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजानेको वज्रहस्तः | सनदम्र्क्तोदयते ||
8.2.e: Thus he, sole doer of great deeds whose hand holds thunder, gives us strength,  He who hath never been subdued.

8.2.d: हन्त वर्त्रं दक्षिणेनेन्द्रः पुरु पुरुहूतः | महान महीभिः शचिभिः ||
8.2.e: Vṛtra he slays with his right hand, even Indra, great with mighty power,  And much-invoked in many a place.

8.2.d: यस्मिन विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत चयौत्ना जरयांसि च | अनु घेन मन्दी मघोनः ||
8.2.e: He upon whom all men depend, all regions, all achievements, he  Takes pleasure in our wealthy chiefs.

8.2.d: एष एतानि चकारेन्द्रो विश्वा यो.अति शर्ण्वे | वाजदावा मघोनाम ||
8.2.e: All this hath he accomplished, yea, Indra, most gloriously renowned,  Who gives our wealthy princes strength.

8.2.d: परभर्ता रथं गव्यन्तमपाकच्चिद यमवति | इनो वसुस हि वोळ्हा ||
8.2.e: Who drives his chariot seeking spoil, from afar, to him he loves:  For swift is he to bring men wealth.

8.2.d: सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हन्ता वर्त्रं नर्भिः शूरः | सत्यो.अविता विधन्तम ||
8.2.e: The Sage who, winning spoil with steeds, slays Vṛtra, Hero with the men,  His servant's faithful succourer.

8.2.d: यजध्वैनं परियमेधा इन्द्रं सत्राचा मनसा | यो भूत सोमैः सत्यमद्वा ||
8.2.e: O Priyamedhas, worship with collected mind this Indra whom  The Soma hath full well inspired.

8.2.d: गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं शरवस्कामं पुरुत्मानम | कण्वासोगात वाजिनम ||
8.2.e: Ye Kaṇvas, sing the Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, who loves renown,  All-present, glorified by song.

8.2.d: य रते चिद गास पदेभ्यो दात सखा नर्भ्यः शचीवान | येस्मिन काममश्रियन ||
8.2.e: Strong Friend, who, with no trace of feet, restores the cattle to the men,  Who rest their wish and hope on him.

8.2.d: इत्था धीवन्तमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिम | मेषो भूतोऽभि यन्नयः ||
8.2.e: Shaped as a Ram, Stone-hurler I once thou camest hither to the son  Of Kaṇva, wise Medhyātithi.

8.2.d: शिक्षा विभिन्दो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत | अष्टा परः सहस्रा ||
8.2.e: Vibhindu, thou hast helped this man, giving him thousands four times ten,  And afterward eight thousand more.

8.2.d: उत सु तये पयोव्र्धा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या | जनित्वनाय मामहे ||
8.2.e: And these twain pouring streams of milk, creative, daughters of delight,  For wedlock sake I glorify.

8.3.d: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः | आपिर्नो बोधिसधमाद्यो वर्धे.अस्मानवन्तु ते धियः ||
8.3.e: DRINK, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught.  Be, for our weal, our Friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well.

8.3.d: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न सतरभिमातये | अस्माञ्चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ||
8.3.e: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: expose us not to foe's attack.  With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and bring us to felicity.

8.3.d: इमा उ तवा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम | पावकवर्णाःशुचयो विपश्चितो.अभि सतोमैरनूषत ||
8.3.e: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth.  Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

8.3.d: अयं सहस्रं रषिभिः सहस्क्र्तः समुद्र इव पप्रथे | सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गर्णे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ||
8.3.e: He, with his might enhanced by Ṛṣis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself.  His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

8.3.d: इन्द्रमिद देवतातय इन्द्रं परयत्यध्वरे | इन्द्रं समीकेवनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ||
8.3.e: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds,  Indra, as worshippers in battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

8.3.d: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत | इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः ||
8.3.e: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun.  In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.

8.3.d: अभि तवा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र सतोमेभिरायवः | समीचीनासर्भवः समस्वरन रुद्रा गर्नन्त पूर्व्यम ||
8.3.e: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first.  The Ṛbhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

8.3.d: अस्येदिन्द्रो वाव्र्धे वर्ष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि | अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवो.अनु षटुवन्ति पूर्वथा ||
8.3.e: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice.  And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.

8.3.d: तत तवा यामि सुवीर्यं तद बरह्म पूर्वचित्तये | येना यतिभ्यो भर्गवे धने हिते येन परस्कण्वमाविथ ||
8.3.e: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer,  Wherewith thou holpest Bhṛgu and the Yatis and Praskaṇva when the prize was staked.

8.3.d: येना समुद्रमस्र्जो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वर्ष्णि ते शवः | सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं कषोणीरनुचक्रदे ||
8.3.e: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy manly strength.  For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.

8.3.d: शग्धी न इन्द्र यत तवा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यम | शग्धि वाजाय परथमं सिषासते शग्धि सतोमाय पूर्व्य ||
8.3.e: Help us, O Indra, when we pray to thee for wealth and hero might.  First help thou on to strength the man who strives to win, and aid our laud, O Ancient One.

8.3.d: शग्धी नो अस्य यद ध पौरमाविथ धिय इन्द्र सिषासतः | शग्धि यथा रुशमं शयावकं कर्पमिन्द्र परावः सवर्णरम ||
8.3.e: Help for us, Indra, as thou holpest Paura once, this man's devotions bent on gain.  Help, as thou gavest Ruśama and Śyāvaka and Svarṇara and Kṛpa aid.

8.3.d: कन नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गर्णीत मर्त्यः | नही नवस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं सवर्ग्र्णन्त आनशुः ||
8.3.e: What newest of imploring prayers shall, then, the zealous mortal sing?  For have not they who laud his might, and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?

8.3.d: कदु सतुवन्त रतयन्त देवत रषिः को विप्र ओहते | कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु सतुवत आ गमः ||
8.3.e: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Ṛṣi and as sage?  When ever wilt thou, Indra Maghavan, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?

8.3.d: उदु तये मधुमत्तमा गिर सतोमास ईरते | सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ||
8.3.e: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee,  Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth, and give unfailing aid.

8.3.d: कण्वा इव भर्गवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद धीतमानशुः | इन्द्रं सतोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः परियमेधासो अस्वरन ||
8.3.e: The Bhṛgus are like Suns, like Kaṇvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent upon.  The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.

8.3.d: युक्ष्वा हि वर्त्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः | अर्वाचीनो मघवन सोमपीतय उग्र रष्वेभिरा गहि ||
8.3.e: Best slayer of the Vṛtras, yoke thy Bay Steeds, Indra, from afar.  Come with the High Ones hither, Maghavan, to us, Mighty, to drink the Soma juice.

8.3.d: इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये | सत्वं नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शर्णुधी हवम ||
8.3.e: For these, the bards and singers, have cried out to thee with prayer, to gain the sacrifice.  As such, O Maghavan, Indra, who lovest song, even as a lover bear my call.

8.3.d: निरिन्द्र बर्हतीभ्यो वर्त्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः | निरर्बुदस्य मर्गयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः ||
8.3.e: Thou from the lofty plains above, O Indra, hurledst Vṛtra down.  Thou dravest forth the kine of guileful Mṛgaya and Arbuda from the mountain's hold.

8.3.d: निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इन्द्रियो रसः | निरन्तरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कर्षे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम ||
8.3.e: Bright were the flaming fires, the Sun gave forth his shine, and Soma, Indra's juice, shone clear.  Indra, thou blewest the great Dragon from the air: men must regard that valorous deed.

8.3.d: यं मे दुरिन्द्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः | विश्वेषां तमना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानम ||
8.3.e: The fairest courser of them all, who runneth on as ’twere to heaven.  Which Indra and the Maruts gave, and Pākasthāman Kaurayāṇ.

8.3.d: रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्राम | अदाद रायो विबोधनम ||
8.3.e: To me hath Pākasthāman given, a ruddy horse, good at the pole,  Filling is girth and rousing wealth;

8.3.d: यस्मा अन्ये दश परति धुरं वहन्ति वह्नयः | अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यम ||
8.3.e: Compared with whom no other ten strong coursers, harnessed to the pole,  Bear Tugrya to his dwelling place.

8.3.d: आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यञ्जनम | तुरीयमिद रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवम ||
8.3.e: Raiment is body, food is life, and healing ointment giveth strength.  As the free-handed giver of the ruddy steed, I have named Pākasthāman fourth.

8.4.d: यदिन्द्र परागपागुदं नयग वा हूयसे नर्भिः | सिमा पुरू नर्षूतो अस्यानवे.असि परशर्ध तुर्वशे ||
8.4.e: THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south,  Thou chiefly art with Ānava and Turvaśa, brave Champion I urged by men to Come.

8.4.d: यद वा रुमे रुशमे शयावके कर्प इन्द्र मादयसे सचा | कण्वासस्त्वा बरह्मभि सतोमवाहस इन्द्रा यछन्त्या गहि ||
8.4.e: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Ruśama, Śyāvaka, and Kṛpa thou rejoicest thee,  Still do the Kaṇvas, bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come.

8.4.d: यथा गौरो अपा कर्तं तर्ष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम | आपित्वे नः परपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ||
8.4.e: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool,  Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kaṇvas drink thy fill.

8.4.d: मन्दन्तु तवा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते | आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं जयेष्ठं तद दधिषे सहः ||
